hook.name: NFTXV4Hook
hook.description: NFTXV4Hook powers every NFTX v4 collection pool: a collection's ERC-20 floor token (CollectionToken, redeemable 1:1 for a vaulted NFT) paired with flETH. It sets a per-pool dynamic LP fee, takes a fixed AMM fee via afterSwapReturnsDelta and donates protocol revenue (listing taxes) to the pool's LPs. Swaps are open to anyone; the owner can only close a sunset collection's pool. No external calls during swaps. Same address on every chain via CREATE3.
